text: Swimming laps with goggles is a beneficial practice for swimmers of all levels. Wearing goggles protects your eyes from chlorine and water, which can cause discomfort and even damage if you don't wear them. Additionally, goggles allow you to maintain a steady pace, as they help you see your surroundings clearly underwater and prevent you from losing track of your lap markers. Goggles also adjust pool length by providing a clearer view, making it easier to monitor your progress without needing to constantly look up at the lane lines. By incorporating goggles into your swimming routine, you can enhance your comfort, efficiency, and overall performance in the pool.
summary: Swimming laps with goggles aids in maintaining pace, protects eyes, and adjusts pool length.
